[b][u]Announcement From The Treasury[/u][/b]

The Treasury can announce that the GDP of Dhornaper had grown by 6% last year. The has been achieved by strong pro-industry policies, trade agreements to secure needed resources for Dhora industries, particularly in manufacturing and construction, and rebounding foreign investment following the new civilian government of President Fereydun Khan. The Treasury expects growth to continue as industries adapt to the more favorable economic environment and as investment, both government, private, and foreign increases.

The Treasury, after meetings with the Ministry of Business and Innovation, the Ministry of Development, and the Ministry of Energy, further expects the first of the two planned nuclear reactor to be built within 4 years and the second in 8 years as planning procedures and regulatory obstacles are being streamlined with a standardised project pipeline and with the aid of Jomsland's engineers and scientists. Both are expected to be operational a year after construction. Both will significantly aid the economy with clean, reliable, and abundant energy and provide thousands of jobs.

[i]GDP Last Year: 890 Billion Tomans
GDP Growth: 6%
GDP Now: 943 Billion Tomans[/i]

Signed,
Emam Qolia, Minister of the Treasury
